name: Operation Christmas Child Assistant
intro: You will run a pretend 10-box shoebox drive: set the goal, count crayons and toothbrushes three different ways, add your own item, and write the “still needed” message — then reload and go offline.

steps.do: On the welcome card at the bottom, tap “skip the tour” (small words, bottom-right).
steps.see: The card changes to “How do you want to start?” with two big buttons.

steps.do: Tap “✨ Start fresh with my own”. A small box asks “Start fresh? The examples will be cleared.” — tap “OK”.
steps.see: The card closes. Under “COMPLETE SETS, RIGHT NOW” the big number is 0, a red line starts “Short on 11 items”, and “🎯 The drive's goal” says 100. A purple “🧪 Test copy” bar is at the bottom.

steps.do: Tap the goal box (100), delete it, type 10, then tap “Done” on the keyboard.
steps.see: The items marked EVERY SET now say “need 10 more for 10 sets”, and “💵 Shipping at $10 a box” says “$100 for 10”.

steps.do: Scroll down to “Crayons/ 24 packs” and tap its green ＋.
steps.see: The Crayons count goes from 0 to 1 and it says “need 9 more for 10 sets”.

steps.do: In the Crayons row, tap the small “how many” box and type 9.
steps.see: The green button in that row now reads “＋9”.

steps.do: Tap that “＋9” button.
steps.see: Crayons shows 10 and “enough for the goal ✓”. A short note at the bottom says “Crayons/ 24 packs: 1 + 9 = 10”. At the top the button now says “(10 items)”.

steps.do: Scroll down to “Toothbrushes” and tap the number 0 in the middle of its row.
steps.see: A box opens titled “Toothbrushes” with “Right now: 0”, “How many came in?”, quick number buttons and a big “Add them” button.

steps.do: Tap the quick number “10”, then tap “Add them”.
steps.see: The box closes. Toothbrushes shows 10 and a short note says “Toothbrushes: 0 + 10 = 10”.

steps.do: Tap the − beside Toothbrushes once.
steps.see: Toothbrushes goes down to 9 and says “need 1 more for 10 sets”.

steps.do: Tap the number 0 beside “Socks”. Leave the box empty and tap “Add them”.
steps.see: Nothing is added — a short note says “Type a number first” and the box stays open. Tap “Cancel” (or the dark area above the box) to close it; Socks is still 0.
steps.tip: In the test copy the purple bar can hide the “Cancel” button — tapping the dark area above the box closes it too.

steps.do: Scroll to the bottom of the list, tap the “＋ add an item” box, type this and tap “Add”.
steps.see: A short note says “Added — tap its name to mark “every box””. The new item sits in A-to-Z order, just after “Glue Sticks”, with a count of 0.

steps.do: With the “＋ add an item” box empty, tap “Add” again.
steps.see: Nothing is added — no new row appears.

steps.do: Tap the name “Grandma’s hand-knit mittens” in the list.
steps.see: Its own page opens with −10, −5, +5, +10 buttons, a “type the count” box, and tick boxes “Goes in every set” and “We have plenty”.

steps.do: Tick “Goes in every set”, then tap “Done” at the bottom of that page.
steps.see: Back on the list, the mittens now have a gold EVERY SET tag and “need 10 more for 10 sets”. At the top the button says “(11 items)”.
steps.tip: In the test copy the purple bar hides the “Done” button — tap the dark area above the page instead; it closes it the same way.

steps.do: Scroll to the top and tap “📤 Send the group what we still need (11 items)”.
steps.see: A message box opens. Under “Still to buy:” it lists “• Grandma’s hand-knit mittens — 10 more” and “• Toothbrushes — 1 more (we have 9)”, and lower down “Please do NOT buy: soap, toothpaste…”. There are “💬 Text it”, “✉️ Email it” and “📋 Copy” buttons.
steps.tip: Don't tap Text it or Email it — this is pretend data.

steps.do: Tap “📋 Copy”.
steps.see: A short note at the bottom says “Copied”.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: Everything is still there: the goal is 10, Crayons 10, Toothbrushes 9, and “Grandma’s hand-knit mittens” with its EVERY SET tag.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️). Then tap the green ＋ beside “Socks”.
steps.see: A brown bar at the top says “No connection right now — the app still works and saves on this phone.” Socks goes from 0 to 1.

steps.do: Turn Airplane Mode off (the brown bar goes away). Scroll to the top and tap “🚫 What is not allowed any more”.
steps.see: It opens and says in bold “Soap and toothpaste were fine for years and are banned now.”, followed by the full list.

steps.do: At the very bottom of the page, tap “↻ start a new drive”. When it asks “Start a new drive? Counts go to zero; the item list stays.”, tap “Cancel”.
steps.see: Nothing is reset — Crayons still shows 10 and Toothbrushes 9. That's the end — thank you!
